MOUD: med-supervised opioid w.draw (+ naloxone = Suboxone)
: partial mu-opioid agonist; acts as an agonist at low doses (treat analgesia) and an antagonist at high doses (treat addiction)
: Injection (Buprenex), patch (Butrans), buccal film (Belbuca), SL tablet
: can be used to control withdrawal sxs in addicts actively undergoing withdrawal from opioids
MOUD (med for opioid use dx): maintenance + supervised w.draw (detox)
Admin: long variable 1/2life (12-40hr, up to 150hr) → accum → tox/OD risk
QT prolong, Torsades      *less euphoria than morphine
: severe pain & for detoxification or opiate addiction
: accumulation may lead to life-threatening sedation & respiratory depression in several days
2. Peripheral: extrinsic intestinal vagal n. & spinal afferent n.
Administration: tablet, PO disintegrating, soluble film, liquid, IV, IM

roles.drugs: overdose: naloxone 0.4-2 mg IV (IM, SC or intranasal if no IV), repeated as needed
roles.note: observe: naloxone is shorter-acting than many opioids
less severe or early dependence, or comorbid alcohol use disorder; ≥ 7 days off full agonists; lower retention
